info.title: install.sh
info.description: Installs mash and mashctl from one release.

command.name: install.sh
command.description: Finds this machine's type (linux or darwin, amd64 or arm64), downloads mash, mashctl and the release's SHA256SUMS, checks each binary against them, and puts the two binaries in ~/.local/bin. It asks nothing and needs no sudo. If gh is installed (2.102.0 or newer) it first verifies SHA256SUMS against the release's attestation, checked against the commit the release tag points to. It takes no arguments; it is configured by environment variables.

exitCodes.description: Nothing was installed; one line on stderr says why.

value.name: MASH_INSTALL_DIR
value.description: The folder to install into, an absolute path. Default: ~/.local/bin.

value.name: MASH_VERSION
value.description: Pin a release, for example v0.5.6. Default: the latest, resolved to its tag first, so the attestation is always checked against that tag.

value.name: MASH_REPO
value.description: The GitHub repository, as owner/name. Default: bogworks/mash. Used for the download address, the tag lookup and the attestation check.

value.name: MASH_API_BASE
value.description: Where the tag's commit is looked up when gh cannot. Default: https://api.github.com.

value.name: MASH_RELEASE_BASE
value.description: Where the release files are (an https:// address, a mirror). Needs MASH_VERSION, which names the tag the attestation is checked against.

value.text: warning: gh not found: checked checksums only, not verified
value.note: The installer still installs (checksums only); one line on stderr.

value.case: Not authenticated: gh did not run
value.text: warning: gh did not run: checked checksums only, not verified
value.note: The installer still installs (checksums only); one line on stderr.

value.case: Not authenticated: gh's version could not be read
value.text: warning: gh version unreadable: checked checksums only, not verified
value.note: The installer still installs (checksums only); one line on stderr.

value.text: warning: gh is below 2.102.0: checked checksums only, not verified
value.note: The installer still installs (checksums only); one line on stderr.

value.text: Verified the release attestation for bogworks/mash v0.5.9
value.note: One line on stdout. The repo (MASH_REPO, default bogworks/mash) and the tag vary with the release installed.

value.text: error: the release failed verification; nothing was installed
value.note: One line on stderr; nothing is installed.

value.case: The tag's commit cannot be read
value.text:
error: could not read the commit of bogworks/mash v0.5.9; nothing was installed
hint: gh auth login, then run the install again
value.note: gh is there and 2.102.0 or newer, but neither gh api nor the public GitHub API gave the commit the release tag points to, so the attestation cannot be pinned to it; nothing is installed. The repo and tag vary with the release. The hint line is printed only when gh is not logged in; with gh logged in, only the error line is printed.
